creator: nocode.joshua
title: Three uses for the new Claude Code 'Mods': sessions that message each other (one plans, one builds), a live dashboard pane inside Claude Code (agent status, second brain), and a model-router mod that sends easy tasks to Haiku to protect limits -- all buildable by describing the mod to Claude

tools.name: Claude Code Mods
tools.detail: New feature; mod ideas on screen: usage meter, session chat, model router, agent dashboard, cost tracker, todo pane, git status

tools.name: Haiku / Opus
tools.detail: Router sends 'easy' (fix a typo, rename files, tidy notes) to Haiku, 'hard' (plan my launch) to Opus

claims: One Claude Code session can now send a message to another; one plans while the other builds and they pass work between them
You can ask Claude to change any of its interface, e.g. a dashboard pane showing what agents are doing or a second-brain overview
A mod can route simple requests to a cheaper model so they stop eating your limits
You can just describe the mod you want and Claude builds it; no technical knowledge needed
how_to_steps: Mod 1: have Session A plan and Session B build; use session-to-session messaging to pass the plan and results
Mod 2: ask Claude 'Build me a mod that shows what my agents are doing' to get a live dashboard pane (Research/Writer/Editor status)
Mod 3: build a router mod that classifies requests as easy/hard and sends easy ones to Haiku
on_screen_only: 'Claude Mods' cube diagram surrounded by mod names: usage meter, session chat, git status, agent-dashboard, cost tracker, todo pane, model router (approx.)
'3 ways no one is talking about'
Terminal mock: Session A -> Session B; 'PLANS' / 'BUILDS' handoff with files passed between sessions

Claude Code window with 'Dashboard · live' side pane: 'Your agents — what they are doing right now: Research (Reading the sources) Running / Writer (Drafting the script) Running / Editor (Waiting on the draft) Waiting'

'THE EASY STUFF: Fix a typo (easy), Rename these files (easy), Tidy up my notes (easy)'; 'BIGGER MODEL Opus $$$'; 'CHEAPER MODEL Haiku'; requests 'Fix a typo / Rename files / Plan my launch (hard)' -> Mod -> Haiku or Opus
'Your limits: with the mod [short bar] / without a mod [long bar] — simple tasks stay off them'
Prompt: 'YOU: Build me a mod that shows what my agents are doing.' with tags mod / agents / doing

relevance.why: Haji runs multiple Claude Code sessions and hits limits; a router mod and a status pane address real daily friction, and mods are buildable by prompt (this session even has a plugin-authoring skill for mods).

implement_score.why: Ask Claude Code to build (1) a usage/cost pane and (2) a simple router that downgrades trivial edits to Haiku. An afternoon; verify the router actually changes the model per request rather than just suggesting it. Session messaging already exists via SendMessage-style tooling.

verify: Exact Mods API: can a mod change the model mid-session, or only intercept/annotate? (the router claim is the one most likely overstated)
Does cross-session messaging exist natively in Mods or is it the existing session SendMessage/Remote Control feature?
Are mods per-user config (~/.claude) and safe to share across projects?

gap.what: First coverage of Claude Code Mods in this set: session-to-session messaging, custom UI panes, and model routing. Liked set covered slash commands and plugins but not Mods.
